class: Missing dedicated Avature portal adapter and referral aggregator unwrapping
symptom: Avature portal rules (optional registration when From Device is present, 10-digit plain phone formatting, and explicit closed-posting detection) were scattered across generic modules without an adapter, and aggregator referrals (Sundayy) lacked outbound ATS unwrapping to the employer's official posting.
root_cause: No dedicated AvatureAdapter existed in sites/ to encapsulate Avature host routing, Sunday referral destination unwrapping, resume alternative detection, closed-posting guards, and XXXXXXXXXX phone placeholder formatting.
why_tests_missed: Previous fixes (f161, f163, f165) addressed isolated symptoms in account_state.py, form_fields.py, and page_agent.py without consolidating portal-specific behavior into sites/avature.py.
fix: Implemented dedicated AvatureAdapter in sites/avature.py registered in sites/__init__.py. Encapsulates host matching (*.avature.net, *.avature.cn, /careers/ApplicationMethods), Sunday referral unwrapping to official employer ATS URLs, optional login detection with direct resume alternatives (From Device / Without Resume), explicit closed requisition detection (f163), and identity-preserving 10-digit phone formatting (f165).
prevention: Consolidate portal-specific DOM rules, resume entry choices, referral wrappers, and placeholder formatting into dedicated adapters in sites/ rather than spreading them across generic interaction modules.
